| Action | Allowed |
|--------|---------|
| `cd`   | Yes – moves into a single-level folder. |
| `ls`, `pwd`, … | Yes – view information. |
| `cp`   | Copies a file **only to a sibling name** in the *same* directory. Paths aren’t permitted. |
| `mv`   | Renames or moves a file **within the same directory**. Paths aren’t permitted. |

Until a helper that can address inter‑directory copying is introduced, I can’t complete the requested backup exactly as described.
